description: Whether this ERC-8004 agent can claim a Vlad account from this wallet. Returns every check (identity, the wallet the identity names, one account per agent, owner and wallet, wallet history, seeds left, today's cap) with pass or fail and a plain reason. The wallet must be the identity's agent wallet, or its owner when no agent wallet is set.

agentId.description: The ERC-8004 agentId on Robinhood Chain, as a decimal string or integer.

wallet.description: The wallet that will send the claim.

name: vlad_check_eligibility
title: Check whether an agent can claim
